packs.explanation: This shipment was flagged because the origin is located inside the Spring Valley quarantine zone. Although the product is frozen avocado pulp, it is currently unknown whether it meets the strict temperature threshold required for the freezing exemption. Additional temperature records and processing details are needed to resolve this review.
checklist: Confirm whether the product temperature is maintained below −17.8 °C with USDA APHIS.
Confirm whether the processing method meets exemption standards with CDFA.
Confirm whether facility compliance records are up to date with the San Diego County Agricultural Commissioner.
